patches listed in PATCHES.md (one file, msm/pippenger.cuh). Every other file is as published.
The CUDA core of midnight-gpu (cuda/midnight_gpu.cu) compiles these templates; it redirects
their device allocation calls to its own wrappers by macro, in its own translation unit.
